iii) You wish to have, notice of the presentation of any documents affecting your property
situated at No.10, Polhengoda Road, Colombo 5, so that you may take steps to have the
document declared void or voidable or in derogation of your lawful rights. What is the
document you may present and to whom and what is the effect of this document?
